message.content:
## Verdict: Partially fixed — bottom nav is correct, but the 2-column adaptation was **not** implemented

### (1) Two-column content arrangements — ❌ NOT DONE
Both 960px and 768px still render as a **single stacked column**, exactly like the old stretched phone layout:

- "Aktivitas Workspace" card is full-width, then the "Kebun Kecilmu" hero is full-width, then "Satu Langkah Hari Ini" is full-width.
- There is no pairing like **"Ritual hari ini" next to "Cerita minggu ini"** — those lower cards (partially visible at the bottom of image 2: "menyalakan apiya 🔥", "Ibu yang sedang kelas Bahasa…", "Bulan Belajar") appear side-by-side *incidentally* because three column tops peek out under the nav, but the actual card bodies are cut off and never fully rendered as a proper grid row in view.
- The "Fokus Hari Ini" dropdown and chips span the full container width, which at 768–960px makes form fields comically wide — a classic sign of an un-adapted phone column.

### (2) Floating bottom nav pill bar — ⚠️ Mixed
- **768px (image 2): correct.** 5 items on one row, generous spacing, center "+" FAB floats above the bar, and the light-green highlight pill is properly centered behind "Beranda".
- **960px (image 1): the highlight pill is misaligned.** The green rounded highlight behind "Beranda" is shifted left relative to the icon+label — the label "Beranda" sits at the pill's edge and the icon isn't vertically centered in it. The white pill bar also appears asymmetric (extra whitespace on the right side of the FAB vs. left), suggesting the bar isn't centered in the viewport at 960px.

### (3) Cramped/squished/broken cards — ⚠️ Some issues
- **Content clipped under the nav in both shots**: at 960px the "0% Habit hari ini" card and the "SATU LANGKAH HARI INI…" section are cut mid-card by the floating bar; at 768px the bottom three cards are sliced through their titles. No bottom padding is reserved for the floating nav — content scrolls underneath with no safe area.
- **"Kebun Kecilmu" hero at 960px**: the quote chip ("Tidak perlu sempurna…") has text wrapping tightly and the illustration overlaps the white stat card's right edge — the card feels squished against the art.
- No card has internally *broken* layout (no overlapping text, no squashed icons), but nothing was reflowed for the wider canvas either.

### (4) Overall tablet feel — ❌ Still a stretched phone
The header, greeting, and nav scale reasonably, but the **main content is a single max-width-ish column stretched to ~900px** with full-width dropdowns, giant hero text, and no multi-column grid. The only genuinely tablet-like element visible is the hint of three cards side-by-side at the very bottom of the 768px shot. To pass, this needs: (a) a real 2-column grid for the dashboard cards, (b) constrained widths on form controls, (c) bottom safe-area padding so cards aren't clipped, and (d) fixing the highlight-pill centering at 960px.
